nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Truly Targeted Acne-Clearing Solution with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, acne-prone skin (including one in a hot/humid climate) report the treatment controls breakouts without added drying, even with multiple daily uses.
segments.dry: One reviewer says the product leaves her dry-prone skin feeling smooth and hydrated without breakouts, though others without a stated dryness history still found it tightened or dried their skin.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describing their skin as sensitive report no stinging, irritation, or excess dryness and good results on breakouts, while one sensitive-skinned reviewer had her skin dry out quickly and needed to pair it with a moisturizer.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes it works well for pimples caused by bacteria/oil but less so for hormonal, fungal, or inflammatory acne on her skin, without more detail on skin type.
segments.normal: One self-described 'normal' skin reviewer in her 40s reports her recurring chin, jawline, and neck breakouts stopped after two months of use.
segments.mature: A 35-year-old reviewer with occasional adult pimples reports the product shrinks and clears them by morning and describes overall improved skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer around age 35-40 with occasional adult breakouts reports clearer, better-looking skin over time; no reviewer discusses fine lines or wrinkles specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report no added dryness or flakiness, several specifically praising it for not drying skin like patches or other treatments do; however, multiple others describe it as very drying, leaving skin tight, thirsty, or requiring reduced use to once a week.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visible reduction in redness and swelling around pimples, often overnight; one early reviewer reports a red spot resolved by afternoon before a pimple even formed.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or eczema-affected skin report no stinging or irritation and describe the product as gentle even during daily use, though one sensitive-skinned reviewer reports quick drying out requiring a moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne scars, and post-inflammatory marks with continued use over weeks; no reviewer reports spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority report individual pimples, including cystic and hormonal breakouts, shrinking or disappearing within one to two days of spot treatment; a minority report no visible effect after one to two weeks of use, and one reviewer reports it worsened her acne.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes her oily skin becomes more breakout-prone premenstrually and this product helps manage flare-ups, but no reviewer reports the product itself reducing overall oil production.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky texture on application
Stings on broken or picked skin
High price relative to bottle size

extraits.texte: I have oily, acne prone skin. This product is not drying on me even if I use it 3x a day. Pimple patches only work on small pimples, so I use this for deep acne, even cystic acne. It either reduces the pimple eventually making it go away or it will bring it to a head much quicker than left alone. I then use a pimple patch to absorb the gunk. I love this better than the patch because its less noticeable in the day, works faster and doesnt leave a hole in my skin like the patches have done in the past.

I've used this for months on hormonal breakouts. It works quickly, doesn't dry out skin and a little goes a long way. Also works on my very sensitive 22yo daughter's skin. She has eczema and this is the only product that works for her. Highly recommend.

My skins sensitive so unfortunately it didn't agree to to much at first. Dried my skin out quickly so I paired it with a moisturizer which seemed to combat it. Packaging was fine. I didn't check the price as I don't plan on buying it.

extraits.titre: Works great for certain types of acne
extraits.texte: This is a good product, a bit sticky but effective. However, my experience was this ONLY works on pimples caused by bacteria/oil. It doesnt appear to be as effective on hormonal, fungal or inflammatory acne FOR ME. But I think if you're experiencing mild, random breakouts this will help. Didn't irritate my sensitive skin or overly dry it out so I'd still recommend depending on your acne type.

I recently turned 40 and have always had issues with acne, not BAD but always had a pimple or two on my face. I'm in AWE of this product. I have "normal" skin. Problem areas are my chin, jawline and neck. I've been using this product am and pm since i got it about 2 months ago and after 2 cycles im thrilled to say i haven't had a problem pimple since i started using it. Even if i have a few little ones pop up, they're gone the next day with this product. Kiehl's has done it again!!! THANK YOU!!! I

extraits.titre: I love this product!! Goodbye acne!
extraits.texte: I am so impressed with this product. As a 35-year-old who still gets occasional pimples, this stuff works SO well with my skin. If I notice a pimple forming at night, I'll apply Kiehl's Truly Targeted Acne-Clearning Pimple Patch and by morning it's already shrinking and clearing up. I would recommend this to anyone. My skin is looking so much better these days! I love that it can be used as a spot treatment.
I could not believe my face the next day! It had exacerbated my acne so I had them all over my face. So disappointed.
